parameters.content:
## Kyrie - PDF Generation & Send  (v5: phone-based Client lookup)

Webhook -> Prep Payload -> GPT Translator (gpt-4o-mini) -> Fill PDF (https://codeeee.onrender.com) -> Email + Update Call Log + **Find Client by Phone -> Append PDF to Client.Attachments**.

**v5 change:** The Client linking step no longer depends on the Call Log row having a `Client` link populated (v4 broke when the upstream scripting didn't set it). v5 SEARCHES the Clients table by phone number (last 10 digits, normalized) and appends the completed PDF to that Client's existing `Attachments` field, preserving any prior files.

**Plug in:**
- GPT Translator: OpenAI credential.
- Update Call Log, Find Client by Phone, Append PDF to Client: replace `Bearer YOUR_AIRTABLE_PAT` in all three.
- Email PDF to Staff: Gmail credential.

If no Clients row matches the phone, the chain skips silently (onError: continue). The completed PDF still lives on the Call Log row and in the staff inbox.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  temperature: 0.1,
  response_format: { type: "json_object" },
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You map call-captured intake answers into a CANONICAL semantic key format for filling a US legal-intake PDF via DocSpring.

You receive: formName, validFieldKeys (the COMPLETE list of semantic keys for this form), rawAnswers ({kyrieKey: callerAnswer} captured during the call).

Output a single JSON object whose keys are EXCLUSIVELY drawn from validFieldKeys and whose values are the appropriate value for that key.

Rules:
- Never invent keys. Only use keys present in validFieldKeys.
- For an address like '1234 Main St, Sacramento, CA 95814', parse into separate _street/_city/_state/_zip keys when those exist for that party.
- For dates, output YYYY-MM-DD.
- For derived keys (todays_date, *_age, total_years_married), compute them from the available data.
- For checkbox/radio_group fields (keys with __option suffix), output true for the chosen option(s) and omit the others.
- If a key has no usable answer, omit it (do not output null or empty string).
- Output JSON only."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content: "formName: " + $json.formName + "

validFieldKeys:
" + ($("Get Template Meta").item.json.validFieldKeys || []).join("
") + "

rawAnswers:
" + JSON.stringify($json.rawAnswers, null, 2)
    }
  ]
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ data: JSON.parse($json.choices[0].message.content), test: false, metadata: { callId: $("Prep Payload").item.json.callId, formName: $("Prep Payload").item.json.formName, callLogRecordId: $("Prep Payload").item.json.recordId } }) }}

nodes.name: DocSpring Submit
nodes.notes: POSTs collected answers to DocSpring. wait=true blocks until the PDF is rendered, so the response includes the download_url directly. Auth: configure an HTTP Basic Auth credential named "DocSpring API" with Token ID as user, Token Secret as password.

parameters.subject: ={{ "Completed Intake PDF - " + $("Prep Payload").item.json.clientName + " (" + $("Prep Payload").item.json.formName + ")" }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ typecast: true, fields: { "PDF Status": "Done", "PDF Link": $node["DocSpring Submit"].json.submission.download_url, "Completed PDF": [ { url: $node["DocSpring Submit"].json.submission.download_url } ] } }) }}

parameters.name: filterByFormula
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const lt = String($('Prep Payload').item.json.clientPhone || '').replace(/\\D/g,'').slice(-10); if(!lt) return 'FALSE()'; const norm = (f) => `SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE({${f}},\" \",\"\"),\"-\",\"\"),\"+\",\"\"),\"(\",\"\")`; return `OR(FIND(\"${lt}\",${norm('Phone')}),FIND(\"${lt}\",${norm('Alt Phone')}))`; })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ fields: { Attachments: [ ...(($json.records[0].fields && $json.records[0].fields.Attachments) || []).map(a => ({ id: a.id })), { url: $node["DocSpring Submit"].json.submission.download_url, filename: $("Prep Payload").item.json.formName + " - " + $("Prep Payload").item.json.clientName + " - " + $("Prep Payload").item.json.today + ".pdf" } ] } }) }}

nodes.name: Get Template Meta
nodes.notes: Looks up the DocSpring Template ID and the canonical Field Keys for the form being filled. Replaces the 1500-line static KEY_MAPS that used to live in Prep Payload.
